# اِسْتَغَثْتَ (istaḡaṯta) /is.ta.ɣaθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
# اِسْتَغَثْتِ (istaḡaṯti) /is.ta.ɣaθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
# اُسْتُغِثْتُ (ustuḡiṯtu) /us.tu.ɣiθ.tu/: first-perso
